title: Importing an existing resume with a review
description: Jobs, projects and descriptions carry across, with the ambiguous places flagged.

blocks.text: An experienced specialist already has a document. Typing a whole career in again makes the start of the work unreasonably long.

quote.text: Not able to adjust, edit add text. Misses many important fields while importing LinkedIn profile. Not for professionals

blocks.text: Show which data from the document will land in each section of the resume. Keep separately the fragments that haven’t found a place yet.
Don’t shorten a long CV silently. The import ends once the content has been checked, and choosing a compact version belongs to the next step.
